symptoms: Brown spots with lighter centres and target-like rings, on leaves, stems and fruit.
favoured_by: Warm, humid weather with long periods of leaf wetness.
cultural_practices: Remove lower infected leaves. Improve airflow. Clear crop debris after harvest.

symptoms: Large patches that start at the leaf tip or edges, with alternating light tan and dark brown bands. The leaf looks scalded.
favoured_by: Wet, humid weather and heavy nitrogen.
cultural_practices: Use balanced nitrogen. Use clean seed. Remove infected stubble after harvest.

symptoms: Short, narrow, reddish-brown streaks running parallel to the leaf veins.
favoured_by: Low-potassium soils and warm (25–28 °C) weather, mostly late in the season.
cultural_practices: Use balanced fertiliser with enough potassium. Grow resistant varieties.
